_comment: Facet taxonomy for the unified AMCR u TEATER vocabulary.
Keys starting with '_' are never treated as facets.
PLACEMENT PRECEDENCE (vocab_manager.assign_theme):
overrides         per-(source,id) correction from taxonomy_overrides.json,
checked FIRST. Use it for a single mis-sorted record inside
an otherwise-correct list; moving a whole list belongs in
heslar_map, a whole TEATER (sub-)branch in teater_branch_map.
heslar_map        AMCR nazev_heslare -> facet
teater_branch_map TEATER branch -> facet, resolved MOST-SPECIFIC FIRST
along the term's broader chain, so a depth-2 sub-branch
overrides its depth-1 parent (used both for whole excluded
sub-branches, e.g. 2560 'etnika', and for moving a TEATER
depth-2 group to a different facet, e.g. 220 'muzeum').
keyword match     legacy substring fallback; fires for nothing today
cross-source rescue / LLM fallback (opt-in) / Other
Every placement is recorded in *_placement_audit.csv with the rule that made
it, so the mapping can be reviewed instead of trusted. Sort that file by
'scheme' to correct a whole source list at once; an override shows up as
'override:<source>:<id>'.
'__exclude__' drops the term from the vocabulary entirely; see _exclusions
for why each list is dropped.
_exclusions is keyed by the rule string the placement audit reports --
'heslar:<list>' or 'teater:<id>' -- so a note is looked up by the exact rule
that excluded the term. Each entry carries 'status' and 'reason'. 'status' is
whose call the exclusion still is, and drives the status column of
vocab_review.py --exclusions:
settled          already ruled on (M4/M3); not an open question
open_geo_ethnic  O3/O4 Q1 -- conflicts with the prompt's geographic
guardrail, so reinstating it REQUIRES relaxing that
wording in the same change
open_other       O4 Q2 -- excluded a priori, no guardrail conflict at all
A bare string in place of the object still works and means status 'settled'.
composite_separators is what splits a composite 'X/Y' label when looking for
components also offered on their own (issue #6 O1/F). Both sources are
hand-maintained, so a second convention in a later harvest is an edit here,
not a code change. Per-pair corrections -- link two records no label
connects, or drop a link a reviewer judges wrong -- are 'same_as' and
'same_as_suppress' on a taxonomy_overrides.json entry.
nested_keep lists the keys a harvested record keeps in the built entry.
Dropping one shrinks the prompt payload; 'discarded_ids' and 'bare_cs' are
read back by the enrichment output (teater_category_ids and the bracket
strip), so dropping either changes behaviour, not just size.
admin_stop_words sorts a term containing one of these to the BACK of its
facet, so prompt truncation drops boilerplate before it drops
archaeological vocabulary. Which words read as boilerplate is a judgement
about report language and belongs in this file, not in code -- and it is
load-bearing, since it decides what a small-context model still sees.
geo_guardrail keeps ONE decision in step across two files. llm_run.py's
prompt forbids selecting a country, language or region name; the branches
holding those terms are excluded here. Change either half alone and the
scores measure the contradiction, not the model -- so vocab_build.py
refuses to build a vocabulary that disagrees with the prompt. 'active'
says whether the clause is in force, 'prompt_markers' is how the build
recognises it (a reworded prompt is an edit here, not a code change), and
'covers' names the rules that wording actually reaches. To reinstate one
of them: relax the prompt wording, set active false, and flip the branch
-- in the same change. See data_samples/vocab/6.O3O4.decision-package.md.
FACET ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING. build_system_prompt truncates a *prefix* of the
flattened term list, so priority decides what a small-context model keeps.
Chronology/Area/Feature/Artefact lead because that is what a report line is
most often about; Location & Admin goes last on purpose.

heslar_labels renames AMCR's machine list names for the prompt sub-header: the model reads 'Chronology / období (kategorie)', not 'Chronology / obdobi_kat'. TEATER's depth-2 labels are already human-readable and pass through unchanged.
'Documentation' was dissolved (issue #6, motyc 5424905539): excluding the
purely technical/administrative dokument_* lists and ext_zdroj_typ left it
with only udalost_typ, which now lives in Location & Admin. Implementation
detail, not a reclassification of AMCR's own udalost_typ list.

teater_branch_labels.1: 1) Teorie a přístupy / Theory and approaches
teater_branch_labels.288: 4) Hraniční obory / Cross-border and related disciplines
teater_branch_labels.2900: 10.3) historické oblasti a státní útvary / historical regions
teater_branch_labels.3094: 11) Povolání a pracovní činnosti / Professions and work activities
teater_branch_labels.220: 3.x) muzeum / museums (sub-branch of 140, moved out of Methods)
teater_branch_labels.253: 3.x) památková péče / heritage protection (sub-branch of 140, moved out of Methods)

heslar:datum_specifikace.reason: 3 date-precision qualifiers (přesné datum, někdy v letech) — qualifiers, not periods.

heslar:dohlednost.reason: 12 visibility bands — survey conditions, not a topic.

heslar:dok_jednotka_typ.reason: 4 documentation-unit names (katastrální území, lokalita) — spatial/admin units, not methods.

heslar:dokument_material.reason: 25 physical-carrier types (papír milimetrový, pauzák, digitální soubor) — the medium a document is recorded on. motyc 5424905539.

heslar:dokument_nahrada.reason: 4 reproduction-quality labels (tisková kvalita, mikroštítek) — a copy's technical quality. motyc 5424905539.

heslar:dokument_rada.reason: 14 digital-deliverable series names (data, fotografie terénu (digitální), plány (digitální)) — archival deliverable categories, not content. motyc 5424905539.

heslar:dokument_typ.reason: 41 report/document-type labels (nálezová zpráva, hlášení, expertní posudek) — what kind of paperwork accompanies a record, not what the record describes. motyc 5424905539.

heslar:dokument_ulozeni.reason: 7 archive-custody locations (archiv arú, archiv autora) — where a document is stored. motyc 5424905539.

heslar:dokument_zachovalost.reason: 6 preservation-condition bands (zachováno 80–100 %, ztraceno/skartováno) — a document's physical condition. motyc 5424905539.

heslar:ext_zdroj_typ.reason: 5 bibliographic source types (kniha, článek v časopise) — citation format of an external reference, not a topic. motyc 5424905539.

heslar:jazyk.reason: 9 entries (čeština, němčina, latina) — the AMCR list of a document's language: metadata, not content; includes the non-term 'nerelevantní'. david-spacil 6057405985.

heslar:jistota_urceni.reason: confidence percentages (jisté > 95 %) — an epistemic qualifier; confidence_score already carries this.

heslar:letfoto_tvar.reason: 16 aerial cropmark shapes (ohrazení kruhové malé) — a remote-sensing observation vocabulary, not a site or feature class.

heslar:letiste.reason: 29 airfield place names, used only as aerial-survey provenance.

heslar:nalez_typ.reason: only 2 members, 'objekt' and 'předmět' — the top of the type hierarchy sitting as siblings of real find types, i.e. an always-correct escape hatch.

heslar:objekt_specifikace_kat.reason: 2 field names, not concepts: 'způsob provedení', 'těžený/zpracovávaný materiál'.

heslar:projekt_typ.reason: 3 bare adjectives (badatelský, průzkum, záchranný) — meaningless as standalone categories.

Activity Area._comment: Areas defined by the activity carried out there: settlement, burial, cult, production, mining, military.

Feature._comment: Physical features and structures, and how they are built.

Material._comment: What an object or feature is made of.

Finds Context._comment: The deposition circumstances a find was recovered from.

Location & Admin._comment: Organisation types, heritage-protection status, event types, museums and heritage-care bodies.

Other._comment: Terms no rule placed. Empty in every current build — with heslar_map and teater_branch_map in force nothing falls through. A non-empty Other means a source added a list the maps do not cover; treat it as a build failure to investigate, not a bucket to hide things in.
